Nunu.teamfight: Don’t engage first. After an ally starts the fight, place Kindred W Wolf’s Frenzy behind your team and attack while repositioning with Kindred Q Dance of Arrows. Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero can’t be interrupted by Kindred’s slow, so leave its area. If an allied carry is caught by an engage, save them with Kindred R Lamb’s Respite, but remember that Nunu & Willump also survives inside and heals when it ends; finish them right after the zone expires.
Nunu.build: Get Executioner’s Calling early to reduce the healing from Nunu & Willump Q Consume, then get Mortal Reminder for Grievous Wounds and armor penetration. Build magic resistance against Nunu & Willump’s main damage, and consider tenacity against the snowball and root.
Nunu.combo: Place Kindred W Wolf’s Frenzy where you plan to start the fight so you can use Kindred Q Dance of Arrows frequently inside the zone. Then apply Kindred E Mounting Dread to Nunu & Willump and use the attack speed from Kindred Q Dance of Arrows to keep basic attacking the same target. If you switch targets, you have to rebuild Kindred E Mounting Dread’s stacks, so stay focused until the end.
Nunu.escape: After dodging Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! and escaping the root from Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage is your chance to engage. Nunu & Willump has no ability to create distance, so close in with Kindred Q Dance of Arrows and Kindred W Wolf’s Frenzy.
Nunu.fight: Early on, prioritize marks and farming over forced fights. If Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! misses and you dodge the root from Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage, chase and attack with Kindred Q Dance of Arrows; Nunu & Willump has no ability to create distance. Nunu & Willump can restore health with Nunu & Willump Q Consume, so get Grievous Wounds before looking for a chance to finish him.
Nunu.phase: Early on, Kindred is fragile and slow, so avoid fights when you run into Nunu & Willump and prioritize marks and farming. Look to duel from midgame once marks and attack speed items have built up. When your range increases, attack the melee Nunu & Willump while keeping your distance. Missing marks weakens this scaling plan, so plan your early route carefully for the late game.
Nunu.watch: The knockup from Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! is dangerous. Instead of running forward, sidestep toward the incoming snowball and retreat along the path Nunu & Willump came from. If Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage hits you, you’ll be rooted after a delay, so reposition immediately with Kindred Q Dance of Arrows. When Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero begins, leave its area before the slow becomes severe.

RekSai.laning: Early on, plan your camp route toward marks instead of forcing ganks, and only go for marks deep in the enemy jungle without vision when your team has lane priority. If you spot a Rek'Sai Tunnel entrance, walk over it to destroy it and limit her gank and escape routes. Gank when an ally has reliable crowd control or the enemy has pushed too far.
RekSai.phase: Early on, Rek'Sai's ganks are threatening and Kindred is fragile, so avoid giving up kills and focus on marks and farming. Kindred can duel from mid game once she has marks and attack speed items. In the late game, if your range has increased from marks, keep your distance while fighting the melee Rek'Sai.
RekSai.teamfight: Don't engage first. After an ally starts the fight, place Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy behind your team and use Kindred Q Dance of Arrows to reposition and land basic attacks from within it. Don't stand forward while Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel and Rek'Sai R Void Rush are available. If Rek'Sai dives onto an allied carry, save them with Kindred R Lamb's Respite, and lower Rek'Sai's health beforehand so you can finish her when the zone ends.
RekSai.build: Build armor first to withstand Rek'Sai's main damage. Resistance cannot reduce the true damage from Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel, and Rek'Sai R Void Rush deals damage based on your max health, so be careful about investing heavily in health alone. To reduce healing from Rek'Sai P Fury of the Xer'Sai, get Mortal Reminder for both Grievous Wounds and armor penetration.
RekSai.combo: Place Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy in the spot where you plan to fight. Slow Rek'Sai with Kindred E Mounting Dread, then use Kindred Q Dance of Arrows to gain attack speed and keep basic attacking the same target to trigger Wolf's pounce. If Rek'Sai looks ready to escape with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel or Rek'Sai R Void Rush, apply Kindred E Mounting Dread early.
RekSai.escape: The window after you dodge the knock-up from Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow is a good time to engage. If only Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel is down, she can still escape with Rek'Sai R Void Rush, so check the status of both mobility abilities before going in. In particular, close the gap and pressure her with Kindred Q Dance of Arrows before Rek'Sai R Void Rush comes back up.
RekSai.fight: Early on, prioritize marks and farming instead of fighting Rek'Sai when you encounter her without vision. If you dodge the knock-up from Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow with Kindred Q Dance of Arrows, keep your distance and continue landing basic attacks. When Rek'Sai Burrows to heal, don't give up distance; keep dealing damage.
RekSai.watch: When Rek'Sai Burrows, watch for the knock-up from Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, and move toward open ground, away from walls and narrow paths. Use Kindred Q Dance of Arrows to dodge the knock-up as Rek'Sai emerges. Also watch out for the true damage from Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel and the max-health-based damage from Rek'Sai R Void Rush.

Warwick.laning: Plan your camp route toward the marked side, but only contest a mark deep in Warwick’s jungle without vision when your team has lane priority. Kindred’s Kindred E Mounting Dread slow alone is not enough to make a gank work reliably, so go in when an ally has reliable crowd control or the enemy has pushed too far. If your health drops below half, Warwick W Blood Hunt can reveal you, so recall even if you have to give up some farming.
Warwick.teamfight: Don’t engage first. After your team starts a fight, place Kindred W Wolf’s Frenzy behind your allies and attack while adjusting your position with Kindred Q Dance of Arrows. If Warwick R Infinite Duress hits your team’s main damage dealer, look for a chance to save them with Kindred R Lamb’s Respite. Warwick also survives inside the zone, so lower his health there and finish him as it ends.
Warwick.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Warwick P Eternal Hunger, Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast, and Warwick R Infinite Duress. Also get armor against his physical basic attack damage. If you expect a long fight, get healing reduction with Executioner’s Calling, then upgrade into Mortal Reminder.
Warwick.combo: Place Kindred W Wolf’s Frenzy where the fight will happen. Apply Kindred E Mounting Dread to the same target, then use Kindred Q Dance of Arrows to gain attack speed and keep basic attacking to trigger the wolf’s pounce. If Warwick E Primal Howl is active, create distance and use this sequence after the fear triggers.
Warwick.escape: If only Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast is down, don’t engage too soon because he can come back in with Warwick R Infinite Duress. The opening is after Warwick E Primal Howl’s fear triggers and before Warwick R Infinite Duress comes back up. Then place Kindred W Wolf’s Frenzy and attack while adjusting your distance with Kindred Q Dance of Arrows.
Warwick.fight: Early on, prioritize marks and farming over forcing a fight with Warwick. During a fight, don’t commit your damage while Warwick E Primal Howl is active; attack again after the fear triggers. Before Warwick R Infinite Duress comes back up, use Kindred Q Dance of Arrows to adjust your position and maintain distance from within Kindred W Wolf’s Frenzy.
Warwick.phase: Kindred is fragile and slow early, so prioritize marks and farming to avoid giving Warwick a kill. Look for duels from midgame onward, once you’ve stacked marks and have attack speed items. In the late game, use the range gained from marks, but don’t step forward recklessly if you missed marks and fell behind in growth.
Warwick.watch: Warwick W Blood Hunt reveals Kindred’s location when she is below half health and increases Warwick’s movement and attack speed. While Warwick E Primal Howl is active, he takes reduced damage, so create distance, and watch for him to recast it early to trigger the fear. Warwick R Infinite Duress can reach you from far away and suppress you, so position even farther away when Warwick’s movement speed is increased.

Belveth.teamfight: Don’t engage first. After your team starts a fight, place Kindred W Wolf’s Frenzy behind your allies and attack while positioning with Kindred Q Dance of Arrows. If Bel’Veth’s engage catches your team’s main damage dealer, you can save them with Kindred R Lamb’s Respite, but enemies survive in the zone too, so be ready to finish them as soon as it ends. If an ally dies and Bel’Veth is about to get a Void Coral, back off and delay the teamfight while she is transformed.
Belveth.build: Bel’Veth Q Void Surge and Bel’Veth E Royal Maelstrom deal mostly physical damage, so build armor first. You also need health against the true damage from Bel’Veth R Endless Banquet, and if her healing is a problem, get healing reduction with Mortal Reminder.
Belveth.combo: Place Kindred W Wolf’s Frenzy where you plan to start the fight, then slow Bel’Veth with Kindred E Mounting Dread. Follow with Kindred Q Dance of Arrows to gain attack speed and keep basic attacking the same target, but wait until Bel’Veth E Royal Maelstrom ends to deal your finishing damage.
Belveth.escape: Dodge Bel’Veth W Above and Below; the opening to engage comes before Bel’Veth Q Void Surge comes back up. Q has a separate cooldown for each direction, so watch the direction of her most recent dash and fight while managing your distance with Kindred W Wolf’s Frenzy and Kindred Q Dance of Arrows.
Belveth.fight: Dodge Bel’Veth W Above and Below to the side, then basic attack while repositioning with Kindred Q Dance of Arrows from within Kindred W Wolf’s Frenzy. Don’t try to deal heavy damage while Bel’Veth E Royal Maelstrom is active; look for Kindred E Mounting Dread’s finishing damage after it ends.
Belveth.laning: Don’t recklessly chase deep marks without vision. Route your camps toward the marked side and stack safely.
Belveth.phase: In the midgame, duels become viable once you have Kindred P Mark of the Kindred and attack speed items, but if you miss marks and give Bel’Veth time to scale, you’ll be at a greater disadvantage as the game goes on.
Belveth.watch: Bel’Veth W Above and Below knocks you up and lets her follow with Bel’Veth Q Void Surge, so when she closes in, dodge to the side with Kindred Q Dance of Arrows. Bel’Veth E Royal Maelstrom greatly reduces the damage she takes, so save your finishing attack for after it ends.

Diana.laning: Plan your camp route toward the mark, and only contest a deep mark in the enemy jungle without vision when your allies have lane priority. Look for ganks when an ally has reliable crowd control or the opponent has pushed the lane too far.
Diana.teamfight: Don’t stand in front while Diana E Lunar Rush is available. After an ally starts the fight, cast Kindred W Wolf’s Frenzy behind your team. Spread out so multiple allies aren’t pulled in by Diana R Moonfall. If a key damage dealer is caught by her engage, save them with Kindred R Lamb’s Respite, then finish the enemy as the zone ends.
Diana.build: Build magic resistance first because Diana’s main damage is magic. Movement speed is also useful for getting out of her telegraphed area.
Diana.combo: Cast Kindred W Wolf’s Frenzy first, then apply Kindred E Mounting Dread to Diana. Use Kindred Q Dance of Arrows to gain attack speed, then keep basic attacking without switching targets to trigger the pounce from Kindred E Mounting Dread.
Diana.escape: If Diana engages first with E Lunar Rush without a Q Crescent Strike mark, slow her with Kindred E Mounting Dread, then fight while controlling the distance with Kindred Q Dance of Arrows and W Wolf’s Frenzy. If Diana Q Crescent Strike hits and Diana E Lunar Rush may become available again, don’t engage; create distance.
Diana.fight: Dodge Diana Q Crescent Strike and fight after the spheres and shield from Diana W Pale Cascade are gone. Cast Kindred W Wolf’s Frenzy first, then keep attacking the same target while repositioning with Kindred Q Dance of Arrows inside the zone.
Diana.phase: In midgame, Kindred can duel once marks and attack speed items build up. Once your marks increase your range, you can fight while keeping your distance from melee champion Diana.
Diana.watch: Diana Q Crescent Strike curves through the air and marks you, so dodge to the side instead of moving straight back. If it hits, Diana E Lunar Rush may become available again, so use Kindred Q Dance of Arrows to create distance. Don’t fight while the spheres and shield from Diana W Pale Cascade remain.

Khazix.laning: Early on, do not force a chase for a mark in enemy territory without vision; attempt it only when your team has lane priority. Keep vision in river and the bushes at jungle entrances to watch for Kha'Zix approaching, and prioritize camps and marks if a gank opportunity is unclear.
Khazix.teamfight: Wait for an ally to start the fight, then place Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy behind your team and attack while repositioning with Kindred Q Dance of Arrows inside its area. Do not stand in front while Kha'Zix E Leap is available; stay near your allies to avoid isolation. If a carry is caught by Kha'Zix's engage, you can save them with Kindred R Lamb's Respite, but remember Kha'Zix also survives inside the zone and finish him immediately when it ends.
Khazix.build: Kha'Zix's main abilities deal physical damage, so prioritize armor. If the healing from Kha'Zix W Void Spike becomes a problem, get healing reduction and armor penetration with Mortal Reminder.
Khazix.combo: Place Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy where you plan to fight and slow Kha'Zix with Kindred E Mounting Dread. Then use Kindred Q Dance of Arrows to increase your attack speed and keep basic attacking without switching targets to trigger Kindred E Mounting Dread's pounce.
Khazix.escape: The moment after Kha'Zix uses E Leap to engage is your window to counterattack. Slow him with Kindred E Mounting Dread, then manage distance with Kindred Q Dance of Arrows inside Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy.
Khazix.fight: Do not commit too deeply first while Kha'Zix E Leap is available. Right after Kha'Zix engages with E Leap, place Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy, reposition with Kindred Q Dance of Arrows inside its area, and keep basic attacking one target.
Khazix.phase: Early on, Kindred is fragile and slow, so prioritize farming and marks over forcing encounters with Kha'Zix. In mid game, you can duel once marks and attack speed items have accumulated, but stop acting alone if Kha'Zix has stacked two or more evolutions. In late game, use the range gained from marks while avoiding positions where Kha'Zix can isolate you.
Khazix.watch: Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear deals much more damage when you are isolated, so avoid being alone and separated from your allies. If Kha'Zix engages with E Leap, manage distance with Kindred E Mounting Dread's slow and Kindred Q Dance of Arrows. When Kha'Zix disappears with R Void Assault, stay with your allies and counterattack when he reappears instead of chasing his position.

Skarner.laning: Plan Kindred's camp route toward marks, but only go for marks deep in Skarner's jungle without vision when your team has lane priority. Gank when an ally has reliable crowd control or the enemy has pushed too far; otherwise, build marks through farming and counterjungling. Choose fights carefully, because dying in a forced early encounter with Skarner delays your mark growth.
Skarner.teamfight: After an ally starts the fight, place Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy behind your team, then use Kindred Q Dance of Arrows to dodge Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and attack from within the zone. If Skarner's engage catches your carry, Kindred R Lamb's Respite can save them, but account for Skarner surviving inside it too. Near objectives, watch your position at the edge so Skarner R Impale doesn't drag you into the pit.
Skarner.build: Decide in advance whether to include Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar in your build to counter Skarner R Impale's suppression. If you build resistance, prioritize magic resistance against Skarner P Threads of Vibration, W Seismic Bastion, and R Impale. Skarner P Threads of Vibration and Q Shattered Earth / Upheaval deal max-health-based damage, so be wary of investing heavily in health alone.
Skarner.combo: Place Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy where the opponent will stand, apply Kindred E Mounting Dread, then weave in Kindred Q Dance of Arrows and repeatedly basic attack the same target. Use the attack speed from Kindred Q Dance of Arrows to quickly meet the conditions for Kindred E Mounting Dread's pounce. If Skarner looks ready to escape with E Ixtal's Impact, use the slow from Kindred E Mounting Dread first.
Skarner.escape: The moment after you force Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is your window to close the gap. Follow with Kindred Q Dance of Arrows and W Wolf's Frenzy, but don't force your way into Skarner R Impale's suppression range while it's available.
Skarner.fight: Stay away from walls and keep your distance while Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is available. Bait out that charge, then place Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy and attack while repositioning with Kindred Q Dance of Arrows inside the zone. Fight outside melee range so you don't keep taking empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth / Upheaval.
Skarner.phase: Early on, Kindred is fragile and has low movement speed, so prioritize marks and farming over forcing an encounter with Skarner. A duel becomes viable in mid game once you have marks and attack speed items, and increased range makes it easier to keep your distance from the close-range Skarner. If you miss marks or give Skarner time to scale, his tankiness and ability to keep you locked down become difficult to deal with in the late game.
Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact charges through terrain, causes a stun on wall impact, and lets him re-engage quickly. Don't stand with your back to a wall; use Kindred Q Dance of Arrows to position in open space. Skarner R Impale's suppression cannot be removed with Kindred Q Dance of Arrows, so don't enter its range first.

MasterYi.laning: Early on, don’t force marks in the enemy jungle when you have no vision. Go for marks and counterjungling when your team has lane priority. Take available objectives during the period when Master Yi’s early jungle clear and ganking are weak to disrupt his scaling. Gank when an ally has reliable crowd control or the enemy has pushed their lane too far.
MasterYi.build: Master Yi E Wuju Style’s true damage can’t be blocked by armor, so build health too. If the healing from Master Yi W Meditate is a problem, get Mortal Reminder for Grievous Wounds.
MasterYi.combo: Place Kindred W Wolf’s Frenzy first, then apply Kindred E Mounting Dread when Master Yi finishes Master Yi Q Alpha Strike and lands. Follow with Kindred Q Dance of Arrows to build attack speed, then keep basic attacking the same target to trigger Kindred E Mounting Dread’s pounce. Pounce scales with the target’s missing health, so mark them and deal damage to lower their health before triggering it.
MasterYi.escape: Right after Master Yi uses Master Yi Q Alpha Strike is your window to close the gap or pick him off. Wait until he lands, place Kindred W Wolf’s Frenzy, then engage while controlling the distance with Kindred Q Dance of Arrows.
MasterYi.fight: Fight after making Master Yi use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike, when he lands. Continue basic attacking while repositioning inside Kindred W Wolf’s Frenzy with Kindred Q Dance of Arrows. If Master Yi R Highlander is active, don’t rely on the slow from Kindred E Mounting Dread; control the distance with Kindred Q Dance of Arrows.
MasterYi.phase: Early on, pressure Master Yi’s weak jungle control with marks and objectives, but don’t force a fight without vision since Kindred is fragile too. In midgame, once marks and attack speed items are in place, Kindred can duel effectively and begins to gain range. Master Yi gets stronger as the game goes on, so don’t delay taking the advantages available early.
MasterYi.teamfight: After an ally starts the fight, place Kindred W Wolf’s Frenzy behind your team and attack while repositioning inside it with Kindred Q Dance of Arrows. If Master Yi Q Alpha Strike catches an allied carry, prevent the kill with Kindred R Lamb’s Respite to reduce Master Yi’s chances to keep diving. Kindred R Lamb’s Respite also saves enemies, so damage Master Yi inside the zone and finish him right after it ends.
MasterYi.watch: Master Yi can’t be targeted while using Master Yi Q Alpha Strike, so don’t waste Kindred E Mounting Dread before he lands. When Master Yi R Highlander is active, slows won’t affect him, so Kindred E Mounting Dread alone can’t create distance. Account for the true damage from Master Yi E Wuju Style and don’t stay in a prolonged basic attack trade.

Evelynn.build: To counter healing from Evelynn P Demon Shade, get Mortal Reminder, which applies Grievous Wounds with your basic attacks. Prioritize magic resistance against Evelynn’s main damage, but first avoid Evelynn W Allure before its mark matures, since it reduces your resistance.
Evelynn.combo: Cast Kindred W Wolf’s Frenzy first, then slow Evelynn with Kindred E Mounting Dread. Use Kindred Q Dance of Arrows to gain attack speed, then keep basic attacking the same target to trigger the finishing damage from Kindred E Mounting Dread.
Evelynn.escape: Don’t go in as soon as Evelynn E Whiplash is down; check whether Evelynn R Last Caress is still available too. In particular, before Evelynn R Last Caress comes back up, close the distance with Kindred Q Dance of Arrows and Kindred W Wolf’s Frenzy when you’re not at risk of being charmed.
Evelynn.fight: Before the mark from Evelynn W Allure matures, use Kindred Q Dance of Arrows to create distance. When you have a chance to fight, cast Kindred W Wolf’s Frenzy first, then reposition with Kindred Q Dance of Arrows inside the zone and keep basic attacking.
Evelynn.laning: Carry a Control Ward, and place vision near the jungle camps where Evelynn could start a fight.
Evelynn.phase: In midgame, you can duel once marks and attack speed items are in place. Your late game strength depends on mark growth, so don’t engage first if you missed marks.
Evelynn.teamfight: After an ally starts the fight, cast Kindred W Wolf’s Frenzy behind your team and reposition with Kindred Q Dance of Arrows inside the zone, watching for Evelynn to flank your backline. Just after Evelynn catches a key damage dealer, Kindred R Lamb’s Respite can block the finishing damage, but Evelynn also survives inside the zone, so time your finish for when it ends.
Evelynn.watch: If you see the mark from Evelynn W Allure, back away before the charm completes and alert your allies.
